name_input: Ninety One Cycles (AlphaVector India Pvt. Ltd.)
export_evidence: ImportKey page for slug 'alphavector-india-private-limited' (https://importkey.com/countries/india/alphavector-india-private-limited) returned header 'Total Shipments 496 Records detected', 'Trading Partners 17', 'Latest Cargo 2026-02-21' — but every visible row is an INBOUND shipment into India, e.g. exact line: '2026-02-21 | ZHEJIANG JINTUO MECHANICAL ELECTRICAL CO.,LTD | ALPHAVECTOR (INDIA)PRIVATE LIMITED | EXERCISE BIKE | Ningbo, CHINA -> NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India | 95069190 | BOL 7667997'. Rows actually seen: 5 of 496 (all imports; destinations Ningbo/Shekou/Singapore -> Chennai Sea, Nhava Sheva). No outbound (India -> foreign) record with date, destination and B/L was visible on any page I could open. Second slug variant 'alphavector-india-pvt-ltd' returned an empty record table (0 rows seen).
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report revenue split could be retrieved: zaubacorp.com, thecompanycheck.com, tofler.in, volza.com, eximpedia.app, trademo.com all returned HTTP 403/404 and importgenius.com returned a JavaScript challenge. web_search backend was unavailable ('searx: Connection refused') for all queries, so no domestic-supply source could be located. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in anything I could read.
note: Legal entity ALPHAVECTOR (INDIA)PRIVATE LIMITED is live in Indian customs data (address on record: 7, Swastik Super Market, Ashram Road; 496 import records, latest 2026-02-21), so the company exists and is active — but the only verified shipment flow is IMPORT of bicycles/fitness goods from China (HS 87149990 bicycle parts, 95069190 exercise bikes/treadmills, 90191020 massagers, 84231000 scales). Declared HS 871160 (e-bikes) is not the code seen in the records; per project rules this is not a rejection ground — actual observed codes are 87149990 / 95069190 etc., verdict would be accepted_hs_corrected. On Rule 5: no export shipment evidence found (export_status none_found, not 'declared only' — the company's own site/catalogue claims were not used as evidence), and no domestic supply evidence (GST/tender/contract) could be verified because all registry and tender sources were blocked — hence domestic_status unknown rather than none_found. Do not read this as 'no domestic sales'; it means unverified. Recommend re-run with a working search backend and paid Volza/Eximpedia export view before finalising.
